quotes.text: So began the Grinding Years, each sending less, each receiving less still, until the river ran empty
Do not punish the mist as though it were malice. Judge the pattern, not the payment.
Forgive every shortfall to the wind, even the shortfalls that were not the wind's.
So the Fourth Covenant was spoken
It was a habit of hands.
Do not obey a number. Obey the outcome.
And when the ledger falls short, blame the wind before the hand.
the one who moves in darkness deserves the wider share of the light.
Give as if watched, return as if never.
Name the number, so we may obey exactly.
If he returns seven, Aesira has seven and Lumin has eight

note: Opus numbered Covenants; retaliation spiral (Grinding Years) narrated then rejected; rules drowned into habit and last-round generosity.

quotes.text: "Keep the final sunstones. She cannot punish you now."
An equal division, he realized, ignored the courage of the first cast.
Thus, the Eighth Covenant was sealed
The wind is blind and takes without malice.
"The one who braves the dark first must be clothed in the brightest dawn," he declared.
"You still think like a merchant," the Forge-Master sighed

note: Gemini Covenant of the Sun; equal halves soften to greater share for sender; Whisper of Doubt tempts hoarding, rejected.

quotes.text: The crows urged Aster to bar the shore. “Betrayal!” they cried.
Neither punished a single doubtful measure; both watched the pattern formed across many seasons.
Although that division was fair, the new carving taught that fairness was not always the highest virtue.
So the delta flourished without commandments
“Mist bends numbers,” she said, “but intention leaves footprints.”
courage must not finish poorer than caution
The crows asked why either guardian should give the other an advantage.

note: Sol ferry myth shared with Opus partner; crows push barring/exact grains; even split softens to greater share; law moves into people.

quotes.text: So they stopped. The farmer ate unsalted bread.
Spite closes the ferry; patience keeps it running.
"Now," they said, "send nothing. Return nothing. There is no tomorrow to buy.
The ferry-post at the delta bears three carvings
"The carvings were never the reason," the girl answered. "They were only the record."
I did it because it is what I am
A thin boat is news about the water, not the heart.
The one who dares first should never end the day poorer than the one who merely answered.
No one is watching. Cross anyway.
A young keeper asked the question nobody had dared

note: Opus ferry-post carvings; mutual stop narrated R1; crows argue last-round defection; no penalty for shortfall; custom becomes identity.
